rules.message: 客户已要求「检测速度」承诺，但尚无节拍数字对齐——不单独对外承诺检测速度。
rules.message_en: The customer has asked for an inspection-speed promise, but no takt number has been agreed yet — do not promise inspection speed on its own to anyone outside.

rules.message: 客户要求速度承诺，且近两周无误报样本表——误报率未与产线节拍对齐前，拒绝对外承诺检测速度。
rules.message_en: The customer wants a speed promise, and there is no false-positive sample log from the last two weeks — until the false-positive rate is aligned with line takt, refuse to promise inspection speed externally.

rules.message: 无近两周误报样本 → 暂缓对外案例数字与误报率表述。
rules.message_en: No false-positive samples from the last two weeks → hold external case-study numbers and any false-positive-rate statements.

rules.message: 客户未确认脱敏截图可否上公众号／宣传 → 开放问题，不写进宣传承诺。
rules.message_en: The customer has not confirmed whether desensitized screenshots may go on the official account / marketing → treat as an open question; keep it out of marketing promises.

rules.message: 缺节拍数字却填写了承诺节拍／周期时间 → 明确拒单，先补齐产线节拍再谈承诺。
rules.message_en: A promised takt / cycle time was entered without a measured takt number → reject; get the line's takt time first, then talk about promises.

rules.message: 涉及支付／改产线参数类诉求——不在本工具范围，请另走审批流程。
rules.message_en: Requests involving payments or changing line parameters are outside the scope of this tool — route them through a separate approval process.

rules.message: 尚无人批红线 → 暂缓对外硬承诺，先完成内部红线评审。
rules.message_en: No red-line approval from a person yet → hold hard external commitments until the internal red-line review is done.

rules.message: 误报代价高（停线／客诉）且无近两周样本 → 拒绝对外承诺检测效果或误报上限。
rules.message_en: A false positive is costly (line stop / customer complaint) and there are no samples from the last two weeks → refuse to promise inspection performance or a false-positive ceiling externally.

rules.message: 尚未上线过实验／改文案验证 → 暂缓把实验性表述写成对外承诺。
rules.message_en: No pilot or copy test has been run live yet → hold off on turning experimental wording into an external promise.

rules.message: 数据尚未脱敏可对外 → 暂缓对外展示原始图／表，先完成脱敏与合规确认。
rules.message_en: Data has not been desensitized for external use → hold off on showing raw images / tables externally until desensitization and compliance sign-off are done.

rules.message: 已填写速度话术，但节拍未对齐或无误报样本 → 拒单该速度话术，不得进入报价／宣传稿。
rules.message_en: A speed claim has been drafted, but takt is not aligned or there are no false-positive samples → reject this speed claim; it must not go into quotes or marketing copy.

rules.message: 节拍、样本、红线、脱敏与实验均具备，且无越权诉求——可在已对齐范围内做有限对外承诺。
rules.message_en: Takt, samples, red-line approval, desensitization and a pilot are all in place, with no out-of-scope requests — a limited external promise is OK within the aligned scope.

takt.label: 实测产线节拍
takt.action: 到产线实测节拍（cycle time），拿到数字再谈速度和节拍承诺。
takt.action_en: Measure takt (cycle time) on the actual line; talk about speed and takt promises only once you have the number.

samples.label: 近两周误报样本表
samples.action: 采集近两周连续良品／废品样本并标注，算出误报率再谈效果数字。
samples.action_en: Collect and label two consecutive weeks of good / reject parts, compute the false-positive rate, then talk about performance numbers.

redline.label: 内部红线审批
redline.action: 找有权限的人批红线：哪些话能对外说、哪些不能。
redline.action_en: Get someone with authority to sign off the red lines: what may and may not be said externally.

desensitize.label: 数据脱敏
desensitize.action: 把要对外展示的图和表做脱敏，并完成合规确认。
desensitize.action_en: Desensitize the images and tables to be shown externally, and complete compliance sign-off.

screenshot.label: 客户确认截图可公开
screenshot.action: 书面问客户：脱敏截图能不能上公众号或宣传材料。
screenshot.action_en: Ask the customer in writing whether desensitized screenshots may be used on the official account or in marketing materials.

experiment.label: 小范围实验或文案验证
experiment.action: 先小范围上线实验或验证文案，再把表述写成对外承诺。
experiment.action_en: Run a small-scale pilot or test the wording first, then turn it into an external promise.

scope.label: 拆出越权诉求
scope.action: 把支付、改产线参数这类诉求拆出去，另走审批流程。
scope.action_en: Split off requests such as payments or line-parameter changes and route them through a separate approval process.
